visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a brown winter trapper hat and a white Columbia puffer jacket is seated inside a glass cable car. He holds a silver smartphone in front of his face, attempting to take a selfie. Outside the large window, a vast mountainous landscape under a clear blue sky is visible, with brownish vegetation indicating a cold season. He stares intensely into the screen with a neutral expression. (2) The man shifts his head slightly and looks up toward the ceiling of the cable car before looking back at his phone screen. He appears to be reviewing the photos he just took, and his eyebrows are slightly furrowed in dissatisfaction. A bright green cable car gondola passes by in the background, moving in the opposite direction along the cable lines. (3) He continues to experiment with different camera heights and angles, lifting the phone above his head and then tilting it downwards. He adjusts his seating position on the padded bench, looking around the cabin as if searching for better lighting. His facial expression remains focused yet slightly weary as he tries to find a flattering shot of himself. (4) Leaning his head back against the rear glass of the gondola, the man closes his eyes for a second, sighing in frustration. His hands lower the phone to his lap momentarily. The background scenery continues to move, showing the rugged terrain of the mountain slopes and the mechanical structures of the lift system passing by. (5) The camera cuts to a tight close-up of his face. He begins a rapid series of exaggerated, self-deprecating facial movements, squinting his eyes and rolling them upwards. Sunlight flickers across his features as the gondola moves through patches of shadow and light. The editing speed increases here to emphasize his frantic and unsuccessful attempt to look good on camera.

This percussive element contrasts sharply with the previous smooth piano texture, marking the end of the sequence with a high-arousal acoustic event.
